content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: BPCL has notified a total of 154 vacancies across four posts for its Mumbai and Kochi Refineries. Vacancies are tentative and may increase or decrease at the discretion of the Management, subject to Presidential Directives on reservation. Total Vacancies: 154

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Eligibility is assessed as on 01.07.2026 (date of reckoning for post-qualification experience) unless stated otherwise. Diplomas in allied/equivalent disciplines are not eligible for the respective post codes. Candidates with higher qualifications such as A.M.I.E., B.E., or B.Tech are not eligible. Diplomas obtained through part-time, correspondence, or distance learning modes are not accepted. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply.

rows.post_qualification_experience: Minimum 1 year relevant work experience or apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, in Refining/Petroleum/Power/Lube/Petrochemical/Fertilizer Industry
Same as above; Engineering Industry of repute also considered

rows.qualification: Diploma in Electrical Engg./Electrical & Electronics Engg./Electrical Power System/Electrical Engg. (Industrial Control)
rows.post_qualification_experience: Same as above; Engineering Industry of repute also considered

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: General (including EWS) candidates: Minimum 18 years, Maximum 25 years (as on 01.07.2026) OBC (NCL) candidates: Relaxation of 3 years in maximum age limit SC/ST candidates: Relaxation of 5 years in maximum age limit PwBD candidates (disability not less than 40%): Relaxation of 10 years (up to 15 years for SC/ST PwBD, 13 years for OBC(NCL) PwBD) Ex-Servicemen: Actual military service period deducted from age, subject to conditions Total cumulative age relaxation across categories is capped at 15 years

content_sections.heading: BPCL Non-Management Recruitment 2026 Salary Structure
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be placed in the entry-level NG-2 grade at a starting minimum basic pay of ₹26,500/- in the pay scale of ₹26,500/- – ₹34,000/-. Besides Basic Pay, candidates will be eligible for Industrial pattern Dearness Allowance (DA) and other allowances/benefits as per Corporation rules.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Placement and Terms of Employment
content_sections.text: Although posts are notified for Mumbai and Kochi Refineries, candidates should be prepared for posting or transfer to any BPCL location based on business requirements.

rows.details: Mumbai Refinery or Kochi Refinery as per notified post code
BPCL reserves the right to post or transfer selected candidates to any existing or future Refinery/Marketing location of BPCL
Selected candidates must join within 30 days of the offer

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) candidates are required to pay a non-refundable application fee of ₹590/- (₹500/- plus 18% GST, i.e., ₹90/-), plus payment gateway charges if any, through online payment mode only. SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen (ESM) candidates are exempted from payment of application fee.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Stage 1 – Computer Based Test (CBT): 100 objective-type questions of 1 mark each, 120 minutes duration, conducted in English only, with no negative marking. The paper has two sections — Domain Knowledge (60 marks) and General Aptitude comprising English Language, Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, and General Awareness & Current Affairs (40 marks). Stage 2 – Skill/Proficiency Test (SPT): Qualifying in nature, conducted at the respective refinery locations for candidates who clear the CBT cut-off. Stage 3 – Pre-Employment Medical Examination: Final appointment is subject to candidates meeting BPCL's Medical Fitness norms and standards. Merely qualifying the CBT does not guarantee a call for SPT; shortlisting depends on the number of positions, reservation ratios, and relative performance.

content_sections.heading: BPCL Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: Call Letter for CBT/SPT Valid Photo Identity Proof (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Voter ID Card, Passport, Driving Licence, Bank Passbook with photograph, or other specified proof matching the name on the call letter) Matriculation Certificate as proof of Date of Birth (with School Leaving Certificate/Admit Card/Mark Sheet if DOB is not mentioned on the Matriculation Certificate) Diploma certificate and mark sheets; CGPA/OGPA-to-percentage conversion certificate, if applicable Caste/Category certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL) in the prescribed proforma, where applicable EWS Income and Asset Certificate valid for FY 2025-26, where applicable PwBD disability certificate as prescribed under the RPwBD Act, 2016, where applicable No Objection Certificate (for candidates employed in Govt./PSU/Autonomous Bodies)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BPCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the official BPCL Careers website. Locate the notification for "Recruitment to Non-Management Posts in BPCL Mumbai Refinery & Kochi Refinery." Register and fill in the online application form with personal, educational, and category details. Upload the required documents and photograph as specified. Pay the applicable application fee online (if not exempted). Submit the application before 19.08.2026 (11:59 pm) and retain a copy for future reference.

content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Any Corrigendum/Addendum will be published only on www.bharatpetroleum.com > Careers; candidates should check the website regularly. SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/PwBD/EWS candidates applying against unreserved posts will be considered under general standards, with no relaxation in age or qualifying marks. For Post Codes B, C, and D, preference will be given to erstwhile Kochi Refinery Project Evictees, all other selection parameters being equal. Category once selected in the online application cannot be changed later. Furnishing wrong or false information will lead to disqualification at any stage, including after appointment. Canvassing in any form will lead to cancellation of candidature. For queries, candidates may email [email protected] , mentioning the application number in the subject line. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies has BPCL announced in this Non-Management Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: BPCL has announced a total of 154 vacancies across four posts - Process Technician (Chemical), Process Operator/Operator (Chemical), Technician/Operator (Mechanical), and Technician (Electrical) - at its Mumbai and Kochi Refineries.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application and payment of application fees is 19 August 2026 (11:59 pm)

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required for BPCL Non-Management posts 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a full-time, AICTE-approved Diploma in Chemical Engineering/Chemical Technology (Post A & B), Mechanical Engineering (Post C), or Electrical Engineering/Electrical & Electronics Engineering (Post D), with the prescribed minimum aggregate marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit for General (including EWS) candidates is 18 to 25 years as on 01.07.2026, with relaxation applicable for OBC (NCL), SC/ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary/pay scale for BPCL Non-Management posts?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will be placed in the NG-2 grade with a starting basic pay of ₹26,500/- in the pay scale of ₹26,500/- – ₹34,000/-, along with Dearness Allowance and other applicable benefits.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for BPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: General, EWS, and OBC (NCL) candidates must pay ₹590/- (inclusive of GST) plus payment gateway charges, if any. SC, ST, PwBD, and Ex-Servicemen candidates are exempted from the application fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection comprises three stages: a Computer Based Test (CBT), a Skill/Proficiency Test (SPT), and a Pre-Employment Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q8. Is there negative marking in the BPCL CBT?
faq.answer: No, there is no negative marking for wrong answers in the BPCL Computer Based Test.

faq.question: Q9. Where will BPCL Non-Management posts 2026 be posted?
faq.answer: Posts are notified for Mumbai Refinery and Kochi Refinery; however, BPCL reserves the right to post or transfer selected candidates to any existing or future Refinery/Marketing location.

faq.question: Q10. When will the BPCL CBT 2026 be conducted?
faq.answer: The Computer Based Test is tentatively scheduled for September 2026; exact dates and centres will be communicated via call letter.
